description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing sets of object identifiers (oids). It provides functions for adding, searching, filtering, sorting, and iterating over collections of object ids, optimized for large datasets and efficiency.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the array, expanding internal storage as needed.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a specific object ID in the array, sorting the array if not already sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Releases memory associated with the array and resets it to an empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID, executing a callback function on each.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over unique object IDs in sorted order, executing a callback on each.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Filters the array by retaining only entries for which a callback function returns true.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array in ascending order of object IDs.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after a given position, assuming the array is sorted.

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
